audit.why: FAVOURED 4/10 fits 48.63% WR over 2188 games: point-and-click W root plus channel-cancel on Death Lotus is Katarina's nightmare, difficulty comes from not misplacing W.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart read Ryze on all seven rows; content (matching packet) reads Katarina/Skill/Ryze/Skill/Skill/Ryze/Ryze — rows 0,1,3,4 disagreed.
audit.why: Level 1 is hers (Q Bouncing Blade off the wave out-pokes a rangeless Ryze 1), 2 and 4-5 and 6 are even (she needs her full combo; W cancels Lotus). Blanket Ryze oversold it.
audit.corrected: Full phases[0,1,3,4].side moved to match content, with why/rating rewrites for each moved row.

audit.whatIsWrong: tldr/winCon/report[1] said 'a shield behind it' / 'shield the burst' — current Ryze has no shield; Katarina called he/him in 15+ fields; cooldowns field had no digit; two bullets were tradeGood/tradeBad pasted verbatim; the decisive interaction (W Rune Prison cancels Death Lotus, a channel) was absent from the full layer's headline fields.
audit.why: Katarina is she/her. Death Lotus is a channel (75/60/45s) and any CC cancels it — Ryze's point-and-click W is the clean answer. Shunpo is 12-8s but resets on takedowns, so counting it only matters pre-fight. E Shunpo is her only gap-closer, blinking to daggers and targets.
audit.corrected: Shield claims replaced with the Lotus-cancel interaction, pronouns fixed, cooldowns rewritten with 12s/8s/75s/11s numbers, bleed bullets replaced with dagger-zone and reset-range bodies.

edits.before: - Katarina Shunpo: matchup-defining — Her blink to daggers and targets — hard CC during her resets and she folds. It governs your forward steps. - W Rune Prison spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
